issues.where: the smoke plume above the cave and the sky behind it, between 3.27 s and 3.82 s
issues.what: the tall grey plume disappears between two samples and is swapped for a flat orange haze lying across the far cliff. It does not thin out or drift off. At playing speed this reads as a pop or a state change
issues.fix: keep one smoke simulation running the whole time. Let the plume shear, thin and spread into the haze over several seconds instead of cutting between two smoke states

issues.where: the walking creatures on the lava plain in the middle distance, from 3.27 s to 3.82 s
issues.what: the herd jumps to new positions and a new layout between samples, and some animals appear on the right where there were none. Before that, from 0 to 3.27 s, they hardly move at all, so they read as placed models
issues.fix: give each animal its own continuous path and gait phase. Keep them shifting, pausing and turning across the hold, with no re-spawn or repositioning

issues.where: the lava fall from the cave lip down to the bench, over frames 4008 to 4019
issues.what: the branching bright channels change shape from frame to frame at 1/100 s steps without any downhill travel. They boil and shimmer like a swapped crack texture rather than thick lava sliding down, and they never get a folding, crusting skin
issues.fix: drive the flow with a slow, coherent downhill advection. Let the crust plates ride and fold on the surface, and lock fine detail so it does not re-randomise each frame

issues.where: the lava fall and the lava channels across the plain, for the whole 6 s hold
issues.what: the cave-mouth fall and the glowing cracks are almost frozen. Only the glow of the right-hand pool pulses brighter and dimmer, so the floor reads as a still picture with lighting changes
issues.fix: give the channels a visible slow creep and crusting, and let the fall spill and break. Tie the glow changes to the moving lava, not to an even pulse

issues.where: the dust or fume cloud to the right of the lava fall
issues.what: the cloud is almost the same in every frame and does not billow or rise. It sits as a soft sprite that the lava does not disturb
issues.fix: have the fume rise and roll off the hot flow, lit from below by the lava, and keep it moving

issues.where: the steam vent on the left rock and the waterline at the lower right
issues.what: the steam shifts very little and the shore water stays fixed for 6 s
issues.fix: add a gentle, varied puffing to the vent and a small lapping motion at the waterline
